capabilities: Convert notes to tasks or projects
Display tasks and projects in a sidebar
Query tasks using Bases or Dataview
disambiguation: Not an Obsidian task manager; it is a bridge that allows Obsidian to feed tasks into the external PrimeTask application.
extras: All traffic is local (127.0.0.1); no telemetry; requires explicit authorization via PrimeTask app.
motivation: To connect PrimeTask and Obsidian without forcing either application to fundamentally change its core function.
problem: Users need a way to capture ideas from unstructured notes into a dedicated task management system without forcing the note-taking app to become a full task manager.

relations.evidence: Requires the PrimeTask desktop app running on the same machine.
query them with Bases or Dataview.
Dataview works the same way if you have it installed.

summary: A synchronization plugin that connects Obsidian notes to the PrimeTask desktop application, allowing task capture, sidebar browsing, and database querying.
